name: GOOGLE
description: Google Java Style Guide - emphasises clarity, consistency and readability.

rules.name: Column limit
rules.description: Java source lines are limited to 100 characters.
rules.suggestion: Split long lines across multiple lines to improve readability.

rules.name: No wildcard imports
rules.description: Wildcard imports are not allowed, whether static or regular.
rules.suggestion: Import each required class explicitly to avoid name collisions and unclear dependencies.

rules.name: Overload grouping
rules.description: Overloaded methods should appear together, with no other methods between them.
rules.suggestion: Keep overloaded methods adjacent for readability.

rules.name: Class naming convention
rules.suggestion: Class names should follow UpperCamelCase, e.g. MyClass.

rules.name: Method naming convention
rules.suggestion: Method names should follow lowerCamelCase, e.g. myMethod.

rules.name: Constant naming convention
rules.description: Constant names must be all upper case with underscores between words.
rules.suggestion: Constants should use CONSTANT_CASE, e.g. MAX_COUNT.

rules.name: Braces are required
rules.description: Braces are used with if, else, for, do and while, even for a single statement (K&R style).
rules.suggestion: Always use braces, even for a single-line body.

rules.name: Array declaration style
rules.description: Array brackets belong with the type, not the variable name.
rules.suggestion: Prefer String[] args over String args[].

rules.name: Switch Default
rules.description: A switch statement must include a default branch.
rules.suggestion: Include a default branch in the switch statement.

rules.name: Fall-through comment
rules.description: A switch case that falls through must be documented with a comment.
rules.suggestion: Add an explicit '// fall through' comment, or use break.

rules.name: Modifier order
rules.description: Class and member modifiers should follow the order recommended by the Java Language Specification.
rules.suggestion: Recommended order: public/protected/private abstract static final transient volatile synchronized native strictfp.

rules.name: Exception catching
rules.description: Do not catch the generic Exception type except at the top level.
rules.suggestion: Catch specific exception types rather than the generic Exception.

rules.name: Empty catch block
rules.description: Do not leave a catch block empty.
rules.suggestion: At minimum log the exception, or add a comment explaining why it is ignored.

rules.name: Avoid finalizers
rules.suggestion: Avoid finalize(); use try-with-resources or release resources explicitly.
